theorem bbolt.node.free.wp_proof [hos : HasExt osFsExt] (hTxid :
    bbolt.internal.common.Meta.Txid.spec) (hPage : bbolt.Tx.page.spec) (hFree :
    bbolt.internal.freelist.Interface.Free.spec) : bbolt.node.free.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.node.free.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (w : bbolt.WDb) (bl n : Loc) (rn : bbolt.NRec),
    X.node bl n = some rn →
      rn.nv.bucket' = bl →
        (rn.nv.pgid' ≠ W64 0 →
            X.t.pm !! rn.nv.pgid' = none ∧
              X.t.mv.txid' = w.wtxid ∧
                ∃ pg,
                  X.v.pages !! BitVec.toNat rn.nv.pgid' = some pg ∧
                    16 ≤ pg.length ∧
                      bbolt.pageId pg = BitVec.toNat rn.nv.pgid' ∧
                        (bbolt.pageFlags pg = bbolt.branchPageFlag ∨ bbolt.pageFlags pg = bbolt.leafPageFlag) ∧
                          w.fl.canFree w.wtxid rn.nv.pgid' (1 + bbolt.pageOverflow pg)) →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗ bbolt.wdbW K tx X.v w -∗
                ▷
                    ((∃ X' w',
                        bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X' ∗
                          bbolt.wdbW K tx X.v w' ∗
                            ⌜rn.nv.pgid' = W64 0 ∧ X' = X ∧ w' = w ∨
                                ∃ pg,
                                  rn.nv.pgid' ≠ W64 0 ∧
                                    X.v.pages !! BitVec.toNat rn.nv.pgid' = some pg ∧
                                      X' =
                                          X.setNode bl n
                                            {
                                              nv :=
                                                have __src := rn.nv;
                                                { bucket' := __src.bucket', isLeaf' := __src.isLeaf',
                                                  unbalanced' := __src.unbalanced', spilled' := __src.spilled',
                                                  key' := __src.key', pgid' := W64 0, parent' := __src.parent',
                                                  children' := __src.children', inodes' := __src.inodes' },
                                              ins := rn.ins, ws := rn.ws, cs := rn.cs, key := rn.key, ksrc := rn.ksrc,
                                              capOwn := rn.capOwn } ∧
                                        w' =
                                          w.withFl (w.fl.freePages w.wtxid rn.nv.pgid' (1 + bbolt.pageOverflow pg))⌝) -∗
                      Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.node.ty.PointerType go!"free" (intoVal n)))
                      (intoVal ()))
                    {{ Φ }}
